$description: Tuck design tokens, final (v2.0, replaces the round-1 Tealight tokens). Source of truth for prototype CSS variables (--color-*, --font-*, --space-*, --radius-*, --motion-*) and the native themes. Contrast ratios are WCAG 2.x, measured against the theme's `bg` unless noted. No pure white, no pure black, no red, no purple, no cream, no terracotta.

night.$description: Night wool. Dark and the default. Warm, low-glare, dyed-wool colours.

bg.name: Loden
bg.use: App background, the space where your audio lives (top of screen).

surface2.name: Seam
surface2.use: Raised rows, notices and warnings (with an icon and plain words).

line.name: Seam line
line.use: Hairlines, dividers, inactive rails. Decorative only (1.6:1).

ink.name: Fleece
ink.contrast: 13.3:1 on bg, 11.3:1 on surface, 9.5:1 on surface2

ink2.name: Thread
ink2.use: Secondary text, engraved numbers, units, the grab handle.
ink2.contrast: 7.5:1 on bg, 6.4:1 on surface, 5.4:1 on surface2

left.name: Heather
left.use: Left ear: L values, left stitch half, Play left. Any size.

right.name: Lichen
right.use: Right ear: R values, right stitch half, Play right. Any size.

lining.name: Apricot lining
lining.use: The layer's turned-down top edge and the mark. Never text, never a button, never a fill larger than the strip.

liningFold.name: Fold shadow
liningFold.use: The hairline under the lining strip.

onInk.use: Label on a Fleece primary button.

focusRing.use: 2 px ring, 2 px offset, on every focusable element.

day.$description: Day wool. Light. Grey-green linen, not cream. Ear colours are deepened and carry usage limits.

ink2.name: Thread
ink2.use: Secondary text, engraved numbers, the grab handle.
ink2.contrast: 5.6:1 on bg, 6.2:1 on surface, 5.1:1 on surface2

left.name: Heather, deep
left.contrast: 5.1:1 on bg, 5.6:1 on surface, 4.6:1 on surface2
left.usageLimit: Icons, the stitch, L labels and large text (20 px+, or 16 px bold) only. Never body copy.

right.name: Lichen, deep
right.usageLimit: Icons, the stitch, R labels and large text (20 px+, or 16 px bold) only. Never body copy.

lining.name: Apricot lining, day
lining.use: Fold and mark only, never text. Moved from round-2 #D9997C (hue 19, read as terracotta) to hue 24, lighter, to keep the no-terracotta rule.
lining.contrast: 1.6:1 on bg (decorative; the handle carries the affordance)

dim.$description: Dim wool, warmed in round 1. Night palette: automatic from 21:00 for every layer and from 18:00 for Sleep (setting: Auto / From 18:00 / Off). Low blue, low luminance, warm amber-grey. Target: nothing on screen above about 40 cd/m2 at default brightness. No Fleece-white text, the primary button is an outline (never a bright fill), lining at 40%, no texture, breathing layer off.

edge.contrast: 3.5:1 on bg, 3.2:1 on surface (control edges, WCAG 1.4.11)

rules: Left ear is always Heather and right ear is always Lichen, everywhere: ear check, stitch, spec card, Live Activity. Colour never stands alone; every ear value also has an L or R and a position.
The lining is the layer's top edge and the mark. It is never text, never a button, and never a background.
No red anywhere. Warnings use surface2, an icon and plain words.
Body text uses ink (7:1 or better). ink2 is for secondary lines and engraved numbers only.

Control edges (chip borders, segmented tracks) use edge, 3:1 or better: night #767E6E, day #7A8173, dim #766857. A selected segment carries a 2 px ink outline, so selection never relies on fill alone.
One accent moment per screen: the lining strip. No gradients except the lining's brightness during a fade.

twill.description: Two 45-degree hairline weaves on the layer surface.

family.ui: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

rules: Literata is the voice: at most one sentence per screen (the home line, the warm status line, onboarding headlines, the session-end line, science headings). Never on a control.
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next is everything that works: labels, buttons, numbers, settings, science body.
Legible mode swaps Literata for Atkinson 500 everywhere.
Sentence case. No all caps, no tracked-out labels, no monospace. 16 px is the minimum size, everywhere.
Engraved, not advertised: Hz and minutes are ink2, 16 px, tabular. The only large number is the spec-card and Live Activity readout.

type.$description: 1.25 scale from 16. size and lineHeight in px (pt on iOS, sp on Android). All roles follow Dynamic Type / font scale up to AX3.

layer.$description: Geometry of the signature object. Heights are measured from the bottom of the safe area (above the home indicator / gesture bar).
rules: The grab handle is the layer's top (lining) edge, never the screen's bottom edge. Its hit area starts at least 44 pt above the iOS home indicator or Android gesture-nav zone.
A visible Start sound button is always present when idle. The pull is the ritual, never the gate.

level.$description: How loud the layer sits under your audio. Labelled by words, never by percentage. Values are engine volume 0..1 (perceptual).

duration.$description: ms. Motion and sound are one event: the layer moves fast, the lining's brightness takes exactly as long as the audio fade.

rules: Nothing moves on launch. The first motion always comes from the user.
The layer rises in 1.4 s; the lining brightens across the full 8 s fade-in (15 s for Steady). Set down: the layer sinks in 2 s; the lining dims across the full 20 s fade-out.
Never draw the beat. Nothing pulses at or near the beat frequency, and nothing cycles faster than once per 6 s. The optional breathing layer is a 10 s cycle and off by default.
One curve, no bounce: no springs, overshoot, parallax, confetti or shake.
Reduce Motion (or Still screen): every movement becomes a 600 ms cross-fade. Audio fades are unchanged, and the lining's brightness change is kept because it is not movement.

haptics.whenOn: One soft tick at each level detent and when sound has fully started. Nothing else.
